主要内容: On January 28, 2016, Optical Cable Corporation issued a press release announcing its fourth quarter and fiscal year 2015 financial results. The company also held an earnings call on the same date. The press release and earnings call transcript are attached as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2, respectively. The report is signed by Tracy G. Smith, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, on February 1, 2016. The filing is intended to satisfy the reporting obligation under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. No specific financial figures or operational details are provided in the text, but the event marks the disclosure of the company's financial performance for the period ending December 31, 2015.
